function.description: Get the count of confirmed field notices affecting a network device. Use this after resolving the device id for questions like 'how many notices affect this device?'. Return only the confirmed field notice count. Do not include or add potential field notices unless the user explicitly asks for potential field notices.
function.name: api_getCountOfFieldNoticesAffectingTheNetworkDevice

type.description: Return field notices with this type. Available values : SOFTWARE, HARDWARE

count.description: Count of confirmed field notices affecting the network device.
